answer: A concrete approach: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the knoll to sunk effort, uses the pigment as an corroborating signal, then requires a orchard before any payout.
